description: Returns Siigo's catalog of products/plans for a country with price, currency and feature list, read from the pricing page (its schema.org Product graphs, or the shell catalogue where the country publishes one). Use this when the user asks about pricing, plans, discounts or what's included in each tier. `price` is the list price of the headline plan (yearly when there is one) and never includes a discount. `offers` holds every published price; an offer whose description ends in "con descuento" is a discount in force, with `regularPrice` (the list price it replaces) and `discountPercent` when the source publishes them. `monthlyEquivalent` is the per-month figure the pricing card shows for a multi-month plan (period total divided by its months), not the price of the monthly plan. Example call: {"country": "COL"} (uses the configured default slug precios-siigo). An empty products array means the page currently publishes no products.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Only countries listed in DependencyInjection:ProfileInjector:Actives are served. Examples: COL, MEX, ECU, PER, CHL, URY.

slug.description: Optional WP page slug whose JSON-LD exposes the Product/Offer graphs. Defaults to ContentProviders:{country}:ProductsSlug (COL: precios-siigo). Ignored for countries whose shell publishes a catalogue endpoint (ContentProviders:{country}:Webapp:ProductsListUrl): there the whole catalogue is returned. Same slug rules as get_page_structured_data. Example: precios-siigo.

name: get_products
